language: C17 plus original SysV x86-64 and Thumb assembly
default: Compiling learner stubs; semantic tests fail
acceptance_scope: Finite mechanism evidence, never automatic objective or full-project acceptance.

projects.scope: Bounded caller-owned ring only; array/view interfaces and other capacities require project evidence.
Fixed 16-slot tombstone table; dynamic resizing and generic ownership remain project work.
Heap repair only; the complete heap container API and ordered tree remain project work.
Insertion/deletion/rotations/reuse with independent structural checks; mathematical height proof and transfer remain project work.
Bounded union-find only; graph storage, alternate representations and ownership remain project work.
Unsigned lower bound and stable insertion/merge; the remaining comparison-sort suite is not implemented here.
Length-delimited naive matcher only; alternative algorithm and cost argument remain project work.
BFS and checked nonnegative Dijkstra; DFS, DAG ordering and other path algorithms remain project work.
Aligned byte offsets only; effective type and typed-object design require project reasoning.
Mark/rewind byte arena; cross-arena and stale mark misuse remain caller preconditions.
Typed int32 pool with generation handles and retirement; generalized typed ownership remains project work.
Capacity, alignment, huge request and stale handles only; not general allocator adversarial coverage.
Bounded compensated sum fixtures; conditioning and error-bound derivation remain project work.
Bounded Q7 MAC and exhaustive single-product rounding; no generalized scale conversion API.
Ring sequence and sorted permutation evidence; other representation/cost ledgers remain project work.
Original lower-bound kernels and checked boundaries plus ABI probes; written invariants and address/cost certificates remain required.
Original stable tagged insertion in both ISAs; C counters distinguish shifts/placements, instruction work needs learner disassembly evidence.
Original sift-down in both ISAs; reused C facade checks heap premise, no new heap container supplied.
Structural mutation checks and fixed-pool AVL only; path cost certificates remain learner evidence.
Tombstone and byte-span mechanisms; callback/context abstraction design remains learner work.
Bounded matrix frontier and checked distances; generic frontier/allocator adapters remain learner work.
Exhaustive Boolean four-bit addition, carry and signed overflow; broader ALU controls remain project work.
Declared direct-map/shadow model only; not measurements of actual host or MCU caches.
Scalar function ABI only; reset and exception frames are not accepted by these tests.
Correct kernel prerequisite plus separately invoked nine-sample hosted CSV; cycles and calibrated native comparison remain project work.
Declared comparisons/moves counters for reused kernels; complete cost contract and proof remain learner work.
Fixed cache trace only; store traffic and device I/O evidence belong to their actual adapters.
Reusable correct workload and optional timing CSV; paired interventions, placement and statistical interpretation remain learner work.

optional_measurement: algorithms_measure emits raw wall/process CPU observations without timing thresholds
not_covered: Physical MCU, DMA, PMU/cgroup access and calibrated cycle claims
